test=[[5,8,5,5,5,5,8,8,8],[8,5,5,5,5,5,8,8,5],[8,8,5,0,0,0,8,5,8],[0,0,0,8,8,8,0,0,0],[5,5,0,8,5,5,0,5,0],[0,0,5,5,8,5,5,0,0],[5,0,0,5,3,3,3,3,5],[0,0,0,5,3,5,3,5,5],[0,0,0,5,3,3,3,3,3]]
out=[]
for r in range(0,len(test),3):
 row=[]
 for c in range(0,len(test[0]),3):
  vals={test[i][j] for i in range(r,r+3) for j in range(c,c+3)}-{0,5}
  row.append(next(iter(vals)) if vals else 0)
 out.append(row)
print(out)
# construct library file
program='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = []\n    for r in range(0, h, 3):\n        row = []\n        for c in range(0, w, 3):\n            colors = {grid[i][j] for i in range(r, min(r + 3, h))\n                      for j in range(c, min(c + 3, w))} - {0, 5}\n            row.append(next(iter(colors)) if colors else 0)\n        out.append(row)\n    return out\n'''
path=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687704/attempts/d0cbcca9117b44429be50328a5ec3220/system/state/workspace/programs/task-36c384d4.py')
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(program)
# load program and demo check
ns={}; exec(path.read_text(),ns)
